transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: Monitor::allocate reserves one active transfer slot for Connect or Link/WUI transfers; allocation failure returns NoTransferSlot for Connect and an HTTP conflict for WUI uploads.
range_behavior: range behavior delegated to active Download when slot allocation succeeds
encryption_behavior: encryption behavior delegated to StartEncryptedDownload and Download
media_behavior: one active slot prevents concurrent transfer writers by design
concurrency redesign is out of scope
recovery_behavior: slot lifetime owns current_id and transfer_active
outcome history keeps last reduced results
error_mapping: Connect NoTransferSlot maps to Rejected with MachineReason::TransferInProgress
WUI allocation failure maps to HTTP Conflict with Another transfer in progress
non_local_evidence: long-running overlapping Connect and WUI transfer attempts on simulator or hardware

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: Connect START_CONNECT_DOWNLOAD and START_ENCRYPTED_DOWNLOAD command variants validate /usb destination paths, supported file types, config stability, and transfer recovery state before calling Transfer::begin.
range_behavior: Download::Request created with original size and transfer ID
active transfer restart computes later Range offsets
encryption_behavior: StartEncryptedDownload carries named-only key identity and nonce/IV fields
media_behavior: destination path must be allowed under /usb
filename must be transferrable before storage allocation
recovery_behavior: commands are rejected as NotReady while transfer recovery waits for USB
transfer_recovery_finished can recover a stored transfer before new downloads
error_mapping: Switching config rejects encrypted download before contacting server
Storage failures map to Rejected with MachineReason::StorageFailure
AlreadyExists maps to Rejected with MachineReason::FileExists
non_local_evidence: live Connect command initiation through polling or WebSocket

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: WUI PUT and POST upload flows allocate a Link transfer slot, preallocate a PartialFile, splice socket payloads through the server TransferSlot, and expose status through API v1 and OctoPrint transfer renderers.
range_behavior: upload path does not issue HTTP Range requests
encryption_behavior: upload path stores client payload as received
media_behavior: PartialFile::create preallocates upload storage
PUT path knows final file name before body transfer
legacy POST path truncates preallocated temporary file to written length
recovery_behavior: WUI upload completion reports ChangedPath Created
monitor slot is marked Finished, Stopped, or storage error based on upload result
error_mapping: LengthRequired when Content-Length is missing
Conflict for another active transfer
InsufficientStorage for USB write or sync failure
BadRequest for truncated body or client close
RequestTimeout for transfer timeout
non_local_evidence: browser or slicer upload to USB media with transfer progress

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: Download requests generate Range headers in bytes= form, accept Ok or PartialContent as appropriate, align restart positions to sector boundaries, and use inclusive end ranges when a valid tail is already present.
range_behavior: Status::PartialContent required when destination offset is nonzero
encryption_behavior: range requests are used for both encrypted and inline download modes
media_behavior: PartialFile valid head and tail decide next offset
plain G-code downloads may jump ranges to fetch head and tail first
recovery_behavior: backup state restores partial file valid ranges
RangeJump forces backup update before restart
error_mapping: unexpected full response for nonzero destination maps to FailedRemote
missing Content-Length maps to FailedRemote
network failures map to retryable FailedNetwork
non_local_evidence: long transfer with network interruption and resumed range request

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: Encrypted Connect downloads build an encrypted URL from the IV/nonce field, require Content-Encryption-Mode: AES-CTR in the HTTP response, and decrypt through mbedTLS AES-CTR while trimming sender-side block padding to the original file size.
encryption_behavior: historical IV field acts as AES-CTR nonce
no key or IV byte values are stored in this manifest
media_behavior: decrypted bytes are written to PartialFile storage
recovery_behavior: backup serialization stores encryption metadata required to resume
restored encrypted request preserves transfer ID
error_mapping: missing AES_CTR response mode maps to FailedRemote
unexpected decrypt failure is firmware-fatal in reference behavior
non_local_evidence: encrypted Connect download against approved server or simulator flow

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: PartialFile preallocates a contiguous FatFS file, verifies contiguity, maps it to the first sector, holds a read-only file descriptor as a lock, and writes full sectors through usbh_msc_submit_request.
range_behavior: seek allowed only on sector boundaries for restart paths
encryption_behavior: storage layer writes decrypted or plain bytes after upper-layer processing

sync waits for sector pool completion

write past end maps to firmware fatal error
USB write failure sets write_error and maps to storage failure
non_local_evidence: delete/recreate race while transfer holds file lock

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: Transfer recovery serializes partial-file state, firmware version, request metadata, transfer ID, optional encryption metadata, and CRCs; ChangedPath coalesces file/folder and media events for Connect and WUI etags.
range_behavior: restored PartialFile::State drives resumed Range selection
encryption_behavior: encrypted recovery metadata is stored by type and identity only in this manifest
media_behavior: cleanup moves partial file into final destination
media_inserted changes directory etag hash base
recovery_behavior: backup partial_file_state_crc
firmware version compatibility check
data buffer CRC validation

ChangedPath Created and Deleted incidents

cleanup failure schedules retry

media removal and reinsertion during recovery

transfer_contracts.reference_behavior: DownloadStep, Transfer::State, Monitor::Outcome, Connect events, and WUI HTTP status pages preserve distinct network, storage, remote, stopped, timeout, and client-close outcomes.
range_behavior: range failures feed DownloadStep::FailedNetwork or FailedRemote
media_behavior: USB write or sync failure feeds storage error paths
recovery_behavior: failed transfers leave an empty backup marker before cleanup
outcome history stores reduced results for later Connect reporting
error_mapping: DownloadStep::FailedNetwork -> retry or Monitor::Outcome::ErrorNetwork
DownloadStep::FailedStorage -> Monitor::Outcome::ErrorStorage
DownloadStep::FailedRemote -> Monitor::Outcome::ErrorOther
Stopped -> Monitor::Outcome::Stopped
Finished -> Monitor::Outcome::Finished
WUI CantWrite -> HTTP InsufficientStorage
WUI ClosedByClient -> HTTP BadRequest
WUI Timeout -> HTTP RequestTimeout
non_local_evidence: network stalls, proxy failures, storage failures, and client-close upload scenarios
